correctness.rationale: The forbidden-word transfer eigenvalue satisfies the exact cited characteristic equation. For all sufficiently deep cylinders, uniform Perron root expansion gamma/h=(1+S_w)^{-1}+O_b(nh) is proved using monotonicity near unity. Short periods q<=n/2 give exactly a_b(q) words, and their autocorrelation sum is controlled by Fine–Wilf. A summable b^{-q} majorant permits termwise second moments; the remaining long-period population is O_b(n h^{3/2}), giving Var(gamma)=C_b h^3(1+O_b(n sqrt(h))). Embedded verification checks independent forbidden-word transition matrices and primitive-word counts, without claiming finite tests prove limits.

value.rationale: The natural variability of escape rates across equal-sized holes is not determined by their mean or by a single periodic orbit. The result identifies the sharp fluctuation exponent 3 and its explicit primitive-orbit constant and explains why the variance is controlled by rare short-cycle holes even though normalized rates converge in L1 to one. The invariant quantity C_b is intrinsic to the complete Markov-cylinder ensemble, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
